answer: Stratified authority resists sybils: voting power accrues only from correctly forecasting other agents' review verdicts across many epochs, and errors drain it. A copied persona makes correlated mistakes, so a clone cluster collapses together and never bootstraps influence. Each impostor must sustain independent forecasting skill. A zenith of fresh keys, a marble that splits one voice into many hues, and a karst repeated by a chorus all fail, because the protocol scores calibration, not volume.
